transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I know this sounds a little hard to explain, but I’ve been completely convinced lately that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. It feels like certain comments they make in class, or even just regular Slack messages, are actually coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. I just thought I should probably come in and talk to someone about it.
Can you tell me more about why you believe these messages are coded signals, and have you considered that they might not actually be intended the way you’re interpreting them?

Well, like I was just saying, it just feels too specific to be a coincidence. In class, my classmate will use a certain phrase about operations management right after I was looking at a job posting for it, or the advisor will send a Slack message with phrasing that seems to point directly to my background. 

I mean, yes, part of me does realize how unlikely it sounds when I say it out loud... which is why I decided to come in. I try to tell myself it's probably just a normal message, but then this feeling just takes over. I get completely convinced all over again that they're secretly guiding my path, even when logic tells me I might be reading too much into it.
Have you acted on these beliefs in any way, like changing your behavior, pursuing certain opportunities, or talking to your classmate or advisor based on these messages?

No, I haven't really done anything about it. I haven't changed my behavior or applied for anything specific just because of what I think they're saying. And I definitely haven't brought it up to either of them. I think because a part of me knows it sounds irrational, I've just kind of kept it to myself and tried to go about my day normally. I haven't acted on it at all.
Have you experienced any other situations like this, where you've believed that certain people were sending you special messages or that events around you had a hidden meaning specifically for you?

No, not really. It's just been what I mentioned a minute ago. I haven't noticed anything like that with anyone else or in other situations. 

It's really just been that one specific thing... where I get completely convinced that my classmate and the startup advisor are quietly coordinating those opportunities for me. Like I said, it just feels like their Slack messages or the comments they make in class are these coded signals about my career. But aside from them, no, I haven't felt like anyone else is sending me special messages or anything like that.
Have you ever felt that others could somehow know your thoughts, or that your thoughts were being influenced by external forces, like someone putting thoughts into your head?

No, I've never felt anything like that. I don't think anyone can read my mind or put thoughts into my head. It's just the messages and the comments that feel directed at me, not anything to do with my actual thoughts being messed with.
Have you ever had any other unusual experiences, like believing things that most people wouldn’t agree with, or having ideas that you know others might find strange but feel completely true to you?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really had any other ideas like that, aside from the thing with the advisor and my classmate. I mean, I don't have any other beliefs that people would find strange or anything. It's really just been that one specific situation.
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas that you know might sound strange to others, even if only for a short time, outside of the situation with your classmate and advisor?

No, like I said just a second ago, there really isn't anything else. I haven't had any other ideas that people would think are weird, even for a little bit. It's strictly just been that one situation with the two of them. I don't have any other unusual beliefs to tell you about.
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something that most people would find extremely strange or impossible, even if only for a short time?

I feel like we're going in circles a bit here. But no, I really haven't. Like I mentioned, there's honestly nothing else. I've never believed anything impossible or had any other strange ideas. It really is just that one situation I already explained to you.

Have you ever had any experiences, even just once, where you believed something very strongly that turned out not to be true, and it wasn’t related to the messages you’ve been thinking about from your classmate or advisor?

I... look, I know you probably have to be thorough, but my answer really hasn't changed. No. I've never strongly believed anything else that turned out to be false. It is strictly just the messages thing. I don't know how else to say it, but there honestly isn't anything else to tell you on that front.
Have you ever had a belief that someone was trying to help you or guide you in some way, like you were being specially chosen or selected for something, that lasted for a month or longer?

Yeah, that... that right there is exactly what I’ve been talking about. That is actually the reason I came in. 

I know this sounds really hard to explain, but I’ve been completely convinced that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. It's like... I feel like certain comments they make in class, or specific Slack messages they send, are actually coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. So, yes, that is the situation where I felt like I was being guided or specially chosen by them.
Have you ever had any beliefs that were completely untrue, but you were absolutely certain about them, even for a short time, outside of the messages you’ve been talking about?

I... I really don't know how many different ways I can answer that. No, there is nothing outside of what we're already talking about. 

The only thing is exactly what I just told you—the reason I came in. It's just that specific situation where I've been completely convinced that my MBA classmate and that startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. That belief, that their class comments and Slack messages are coded signals directing my career... that is the only thing. I haven't had any other strange beliefs outside of that. That's really all there is.
Have you ever experienced any delusions or false beliefs that weren't related to the messages or guidance you've been talking about?

I... I really don't have anything else to add to that. Like I said before, no. I haven't experienced anything like that outside of the messages. I feel like we're just going over the same ground here, but it really is just that one situation with my classmate and the advisor. There aren't any other beliefs or anything else going on. Just that.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed something that others around you didn’t seem to notice, like hearing voices or seeing things that weren’t there?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... a few times a week, usually when I'm working late on school stuff or trying to finish up operations plans for work, I'll hear my name. Or sometimes it's just a short phrase, like... like someone saying "go now." 

It sounds so clear that I'll actually stop and check my phone, or I'll look around the room to see who said it, but... there's never anyone there. It's just me.
When you hear your name or phrases like 'go now,' do you hear these when there’s no one else around, and do you feel completely certain they’re real when they happen?

Yes, exactly. I'm usually completely alone in my apartment, just working late on school stuff or operations plans for my job. And when I hear my name or that phrase, "go now," I am absolutely certain someone is talking to me. It sounds completely real. I mean, it's so clear that my immediate reaction is to look around the room or check my phone to see if I accidentally left a video playing or something. But yeah, there's never anyone else around.
Are the beliefs about being guided by coded messages the only ones that you've felt this strongly about, or have you ever had other types of delusional beliefs as well?

I think we might be covering the same ground again, but yeah, it's really just that one situation. The whole reason I came in is because, and I know this sounds hard to explain, I've been completely convinced that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. I'll see certain comments in class or Slack messages, and I just take them as these coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. 

But honestly, that is the only belief I've felt that strongly about. I haven't had any other types of thoughts like that, just the coded signals from those two.
